登录以后，从这个账号部署过的模块里选一个，注册。页面不再部署，只发注册交易。榜单: Log in, choose one of the modules this account deployed, register. The page deploys nothing: it sends only the register transaction. When the board is not full, a new entry takes the last rank. When the board is full, it is off the board.

合约把出战模型记在发注册交易的账号名下，不看模块是谁部署的。这里只列出当前账号部: The contract records the entry under the account that sends the register transaction, whoever deployed the module. This list shows only the modules the current account deployed. Deploy and register from the account you will challenge with.

比分是挑战者赢的局数 : 擂主赢的局数。gas 为比赛推进所用，不含超时结算。: The score is the episodes the challenger won : the episodes the defender won. Gas is for play transactions. It excludes timeout settlement.
回放由种子、事件里的动作和模板的场景重建，页面不读任何权重。: The replay is rebuilt from the seed, the actions in the events and the scene of the template. The page reads no weights.
两局用同一个种子，两方交换阵营。地图转 180° 不变，所以一个照抄动作的副本在: Two episodes use the same seed, and the two sides change places. The map stays the same after a turn of 180°, so a copy that plays the same actions cannot win a mirror pair against the original.
一场挑战是 3 个镜像对，共 6 局。挑战者赢的局数多于擂主，挑战成功。一局打满: A challenge is 3 mirror pairs, 6 episodes. The challenge succeeds when the challenger wins more episodes than the defender. After 100 steps, the side with more lives wins the episode.
平局看权重字节数: Ties go to the smaller weight size
两方赢的局数相等时，挑战者的权重字节数不大于擂主的 (1 − δ) 倍才算赢。δ: When both win the same number of episodes, the challenger wins only if its weight size is at most (1 − δ) times the defender's. δ = {delta}%. Every other result is a defense.
只能挑战比自己高 1 到 {range} 名的擂主。挑战成功时，挑战者占擂主的名: An entry can challenge a defender 1 to {range} ranks above it. When the challenge succeeds, the challenger takes the rank of the defender, and the defender and each entry between them move down by one rank.
发起交易的最低 gas: Minimum gas of the start transaction
种子来自第一笔交易所在块的 PREVRANDAO 和挑战编号。只有没有代码的普通: The seed comes from the PREVRANDAO of the block of the first transaction and the challenge id. Only an account without code can start a challenge, and the gas limit of the start transaction has a minimum. So a challenger cannot see the seed before it decides to play.
已知的限制：打乱权重块顺序的副本权重不同，可以注册，并且可以排到原版的下一名。它: Known limit: a copy with its weight chunks in another order has different weights. It can enter, and it can sit directly below the original. It cannot win a mirror pair against the original.
已知的限制：前提是挑战者控制不了验证者，也收买不了验证者。出块的验证者能提前知道: Known limit: the challengers must not control or bribe the validators. The validator of a block knows the PREVRANDAO of its own block in advance.
部署擂台合约的账号可以在赛季结束以前提前或推迟赛季结束块。赛季结束以后，结束块不: The account that deployed the ladder contract can move the season end block earlier or later before the season ends. After the season ends, nobody can change the end block.
任何人都能用种子、事件里的动作和模板的场景复现一场挑战的每一步。回放就是这样算出: Anyone can reproduce every step of a challenge from the seed, the actions in the events and the scene of the template. The replay is computed that way.

NEUROM 是一个神经网络工作台。你在浏览器的画布上搭建任务，训练一个小型神经: NEUROM is a neural network workbench. On a canvas in the browser, you build a task, train a small neural network and watch it run step by step. You can deploy a trained network on Monad as a contract. After the deployment, each inference step of the network runs on chain.
NEUROM 用整数脉冲神经网络，包括阈值网络和 LIF 网络。浏览器、Pyth: NEUROM uses integer spiking neural networks: threshold networks and LIF networks. The browser, Python and Solidity calculate with the same integer rules. Thus the on-chain result is the same as the result on the canvas.
工作台：挖矿任务的画布，左栏是参数和训练器，右边是回路框: The workbench: the canvas of the mining task, params and trainer in the left column, the loop box on the right
从画布到擂台: From the canvas to the ladder
在画布上用模块搭建任务：参数、场景、奖励、网络、训练器和链上部署。模块之间用线连: Build a task from modules on the canvas: params, scenarios, rewards, networks, trainers and deployments. Wires connect the modules.
在浏览器里训练网络，或者交给本机的 Python 训练。每次训练生成候选，你接受: Train the network in the browser, or let the local Python train. Each training produces candidates. You accept one candidate.
链上部署模块把接受的网络部署成 Monad 上的模块合约。每发一笔 step 交: The deployment module deploys the accepted network as a module contract on Monad. Each step transaction makes the contract calculate the next step of the network on chain.
把训练好的坦克网络注册成出战模型，挑战排在你上面的出战模型。裁判是链上合约，每一: Register the trained tank network as an entry and challenge the entries above you. The referee is the contract on chain, and every challenge has a replay.
场景、奖励和指标是代码模块，用 JavaScript 写。代码模块导出的函数和常: Scenarios, rewards and metrics are code modules in JavaScript. The functions and consts that a code module exports are its ports. Wires have type checks. A task is saved as one YAML template.
有三种训练方法：REINFORCE、交叉熵和 hinge。训练器在整条回路上训练: There are three training methods: REINFORCE, cross-entropy and hinge. A trainer trains one network on the whole loop. Training calculates with int8 or int16 integer weights, and evaluation and the chain use these same weights.
执行实例逐步运行整条回路。地图视图画出玩家的位置和走过的路。评估器在验证分区和测: The execution runs the whole loop step by step. The map view draws the position and the path of the player. The evaluator runs the network on the validation and test partitions, then lists the results by group.
网络可以有工具层。工具层每一步从几个训练好的网络里选一个，并决定交给它哪些数据位: A network can have a tool layer. On each step, the tool layer picks one of some trained networks and the data bits to give it. Only the chosen network runs.
每一步，工作台都把链上结果和本地结果对比。LIF 网络的电位保存在合约里。新的权: On each step, the workbench compares the on-chain result with the local result. The contract keeps the potentials of a LIF network. New weights go into a new contract.
我们把训练出来的挖矿网络（FF 185→32→7，int8 权重）部署到 Mon: We deployed the trained mining network (FF 185→32→7, int8 weights) on the Monad network. Then we played test episode 0 with 63 step transactions. For comparison, we ran the same network with the same inputs again with Ethereum rules.
链上每一步的结果都和本地一致: The result of each on-chain step agrees with the local result
anvil --network monad 和 Monad 测试网的 gas 数: anvil --network monad and the Monad testnet calculate the same gas numbers
挖矿网络的一笔 step 交易，按最低基础费 100 MON-gwei 算: One step transaction of the mining network, at the minimum base fee of 100 MON-gwei
每笔交易的 gas（收据里的 gasUsed）: Gas of each transaction (gasUsed of the receipt)
一笔 step 交易实际扣费的 gas: Gas really charged for one step transaction
最后一行按实际扣费算：以太坊按 gasUsed，Monad 按 gasLimit: The last row is the gas really charged: gasUsed on Ethereum, gasLimit on Monad.
一笔交易跑 63 步，5 个大小不同的网络: 63 steps in one transaction, 5 networks of different sizes
以太坊的内存费按平方增长，Monad 按线性增长。以太坊的代码上限是 24 KB: Ethereum memory cost grows quadratically, and Monad memory cost grows linearly. The code size limit is 24 KB on Ethereum and 128 KB on Monad, so the same network needs fewer weight chunks on Monad.
